applicable_standards: IS 16102 (Part 1): Self-ballasted LED lamps - Performance requirements
IS 16102 (Part 2): Self-ballasted LED lamps - Safety requirements
IS 16103: LED modules for general lighting - Safety requirements
marking_requirements: Unique BIS Registration Number (R-XXXXXXXX) prominently marked on product and packaging
Standard CRS statement: 'Self-Declaration - Conforming to IS 16102 (Part 2):2012'
Rated voltage, wattage, lumen output, and manufacturer brand name
testing_required: Photometric performance and luminous efficacy (IS 16102 Part 1, Clause 6)
Electrical insulation resistance and electric strength test (IS 16102 Part 2, Clause 9)
documents_needed: Complete Test Report from a BIS-recognized laboratory (under 90 days old)
Business registration / factory license / MSME Udyam Certificate
Brand Name / Trademark Registration Certificate or Brand Owner Authorization Letter
Undertaking / Affidavit from Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) for foreign manufacturers
Product technical specification sheet and photo documentation
checklists.timeline_estimate: 4 to 8 weeks (lab testing typically 2-3 weeks, BIS portal approval 1-2 weeks)
checklists.estimated_cost_range: ₹15,000 – ₹45,000 (varies based on lab testing scope and model series)
checklists.renewal_period: Every 2 years through BIS CRS Portal

applicable_standards: IS 374: Electric Ceiling Type Fans and Regulators - Specification
IS 302 (Part 2/Sec 80): Safety of household appliances - Fans
checklists.certification_route: ISI Mark (Product Certification Scheme - Scheme I)
marking_requirements: Official BIS ISI Mark monogram with License Number (CM/L-XXXXXXX)
Sweep size (mm), rated voltage, input power (Watts), service value, and manufacturer details
BEE Star Rating Label (1 to 5 Stars mandatory under Energy Conservation regulations)
testing_required: Air delivery test and Service Value measurement (IS 374, Clause 10)
Temperature rise test on motor windings (IS 374, Clause 11)
Starting test at low voltage (IS 374, Clause 9)
Earthing continuity and high-voltage breakdown test (IS 302-1)
documents_needed: Factory premise lease deed or title deed and manufacturing plant layout
List of in-house testing equipment (anemometer chamber, wattmeter, hi-pot tester)
Calibration certificates for testing equipment
Manufacturing flow chart and Quality Control personnel details
Sample testing application to BIS Regional Office
checklists.timeline_estimate: 2 to 4 months (involves formal BIS factory audit and sample drawing)
checklists.estimated_cost_range: ₹40,000 – ₹90,000 (includes application fee, factory audit, lab testing, and minimum marking fee)
checklists.renewal_period: Annual / Bi-annual license renewal with periodic surveillance audits

applicable_standards: IS 9873 (Part 1): Safety of toys - Mechanical and physical properties
IS 9873 (Part 3): Migration of certain chemical elements (Heavy metals)
checklists.certification_route: ISI Mark (Product Certification Scheme I - Scheme I Special Audit Route)
marking_requirements: Mandatory ISI Mark logo with valid CM/L license code
Age grading label (e.g., 'Not suitable for children under 3 years')
Batch/lot number and manufacturer legal identity
testing_required: Small parts choke hazard test for under-36-month toys (IS 9873 Part 1)
Sharp edges and sharp points testing (IS 9873 Part 1)
Lead, cadmium, mercury, and phthalate migration limits (IS 9873 Part 3)
Electrical safety and battery containment (IS 15644 for motorized/battery toys)
documents_needed: Factory inspection documentation and in-house laboratory setup
List of raw materials with food-grade / non-toxic plastic certificates
Quality assurance plan and qualified QC chemist/engineer profile
BIS Portal e-application form and fee receipt
checklists.timeline_estimate: 2 to 3 months for domestic manufacturing units
checklists.risk_level: High (Mandatory Toys Quality Control Order QCO)

applicable_standards: IS 14543: Packaged Drinking Water (Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water)
checklists.certification_route: ISI Mark (Mandatory Scheme I with In-house Microbiology Lab)
marking_requirements: Prominent ISI Mark with CM/L License Number
FSSAI license number and batch manufacturing date
Date of expiry / best before declaration and net volume
testing_required: Microbiological examination (E. coli, coliforms, salmonella, yeast, mold)
Chemical analysis (TDS, pH, nitrates, fluorides, lead, arsenic, pesticide residues)
documents_needed: Borewell / raw water extraction NOC (CGWA clearance)
Full in-house testing laboratory with qualified microbiologist and chemist
RO / ozonation / UV water treatment plant flow diagram
FSSAI food license
checklists.renewal_period: Annual renewal with quarterly surveillance sample drawing

applicable_standards: IS 1417: Gold and Gold Alloys, Platings - Purity and fineness
IS 2112: Silver and Silver Alloys - Purity and fineness
IS 15820: Assaying and Hallmarking Centres - Operating guidelines
checklists.certification_route: BIS Hallmarking Scheme (Jeweller Registration + AHC Assaying)
marking_requirements: Unique 6-character alphanumeric HUID code laser engraved on each individual item
testing_required: Fire assay method (cupellation) or X-Ray Fluorescence (XRF) at a BIS recognized AHC
documents_needed: Jeweller GST Registration Certificate
PAN card and Aadhaar of authorized proprietor/partner/director
Store location address proof
Online submission on manakonline.in portal
checklists.timeline_estimate: Jeweller registration: Instant to 24 hours online; Batch hallmarking: 1 to 2 business days at AHC
checklists.estimated_cost_range: ₹0 to ₹2,500 registration fee (based on turnover); ₹45 per gold article at AHC (+ GST)
checklists.renewal_period: Registration is valid for lifetime unless revoked; zero renewal fee
checklists.risk_level: Low for Jeweller, Mandatory for retail sale

applicable_standards: IS 13252 (Part 1): Information Technology Equipment - Safety - General Requirements
marking_requirements: BIS CRS Registration Mark with R-XXXXXXXX
Input voltage/current, output rating (e.g., 5V 2A), manufacturer brand
testing_required: Electric shock hazard and earth leakage test (Clause 2.1)
documents_needed: BIS accredited test report from NABL/BIS lab
Bill of materials (BOM) and circuit schematic
Factory authorization and Indian Representative (AIR) agreement
